passages.question: What allowance applies to the trailer ordered in December 2024 and delivered in January 2025?
passages.excerpt: Unless you elect out, you must take a 40% special depreciation allowance for certain qualified property acquired after September 27, 2017, and placed in service after December 31, 2024, and before January 1, 2026 (other than certain property with a long production period and certain aircraft).
